verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration platform with a public website and visa guides, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. Probes found no such surface: llms.txt returned 404, the markdown version of the guides returned 404, and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. Nothing in the docs mentions agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
